metadata.asset_count_definition: 2000 named candidate concepts; includes complete objects and modular parts. Visual states, LODs, palettes and instances are excluded from this count.
metadata.scope: Planning database from emergent life to speculative intergalactic civilization. Not a scientific chronology, evolutionary model, game engine or finished asset library.
metadata.era_policy: Era tags describe possible settings, not unlock dates or an inevitable ladder of evolution or cultural development. Assets may coexist across tags.
metadata.style_selection: User selected Soft toy on 2026-10-18. Fluffy appearance means rounded silhouette here; no fur simulation or strand requirement.
metadata.materials: Small independently recolorable palette; matte rough surfaces; no image textures required. Prefer shared materials.
metadata.production_policy: Model in batches of ten by function; inspect silhouettes at phone scale. Creature rigs, colliders, LODs, animation, dimensions and engine integration need separate review.
metadata.state_authority: Simulator owns inventory, actions, position, construction, care and consequences. Art and narration cannot manufacture completed actions.
metadata.coverage_limit: Breadth-first candidate list. Regional and cultural specificity, accessibility, interiors, animation and ecological relationships remain incomplete. Not 2000 approved distinct silhouettes.
metadata.review_result: Current simulation has physical hauling, construction, care, cleaning, trail wear and timed horse activities. Crop sales and persistent pair bonds remain proposed; no economy or bond implementation claimed.
metadata.migration_001: Individual asset kind separated from pack family; removed inappropriate construction contracts from care props.
